neighbours.mechanism_note: Similar symptoms, different cause. mitochondrial complex IV deficiency, nuclear type 17: mitochondrial energy metabolism (via MONDO:0004069 inborn mitochondrial metabolism disorder). Pelizaeus-Merzbacher disease, transitional form: primary hypomyelination (myelin is never properly formed; PLP1 / PMD spectrum, POLR3) (via MONDO:0010714 Pelizaeus-Merzbacher spectrum disorder). No shared causal gene; phenotype similarity simGIC 0.28. Assets and trial designs do not transfer between them without expert review. Reactome: no pathway annotated for COA8, PLP1, so pathway overlap 0 is a data gap, not evidence of a different mechanism.
